items.title: Down 39%, Should You Buy the Dip in Netflix Stock?

items.title: Warner Bros. Discovery President Sells $16 Million Stock After 146% Rally
items.summary: Gerhard Zeiler exercised options at $11.02 per share and sold at $27.05, disposing of 52% of his direct holdings as the entertainment giant navigates a trailing net loss.

items.title: Ellison Is Now Willing to Sell CNN to Save His $111 Billion Deal. It Wouldn’t End the Lawsuit.
items.summary: David Ellison is dangling CNN to appease critics of his massive Warner Bros. Discovery deal, but the attorneys general suing to block it say the offer solves nothing. A September deadline and a seven-figure daily fee are forcing a decision that no single concession can fix.

items.title: 1 Large-Cap Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.

items.title: Paramount Threatens to Leave Tinseltown Unless States Settle Merger Case Quickly
items.summary: On-location productions in Los Angeles held just 4,711 shoot days in Q2, according to industry group FilmLA, down 13% year-over-year.

items.title: Paramount puts CNN sale on table to settle 12-state antitrust suit
items.summary: Makan Delrahim made the disclosure at Politico’s California Agenda conference, according to Reuters, signaling that Paramount is willing to go beyond internal safeguards to salvage a deal that has become one of the most politically charged media mergers in years. Warner Bros. Discovery is the publicly traded parent of CNN (NASDAQ: WBD), and the merger’s fate directly determines whether Ellison’s Paramount consolidates control over both CBS News and the cable network.
